description: Return products visually and stylistically similar to a given product ID, using embedding similarity, optionally restricted to specific categories. Each result includes the product title, starting price, thumbnail image, shop, category and product link, and the response carries a licensing note. Assets marked AI-generated are excluded.

categories.description: Optionally restrict similar results to specific categories

include_images.description: Attach each product's thumbnail as an image block. Default true.

product_id.description: The product ID to find similar items for

size.description: Number of similar products, 1-50. Default 12. Requests below 9 are raised to 9.

name: find_similar
title: Find similar products
